summary.text: Stephanie Simacek is a Democratic member of the Arizona House of Representatives representing District 2; she assumed office on January 13, 2025.

paragraphs.text: She has also been an at-large member of the Deer Valley Unified School District since January 1, 2023, and is not running for re-election to that seat in 2026.
She earned a bachelor's degree from Portland State University and a graduate degree from Grand Canyon University, and has worked as a teacher.
She advanced from the July 21, 2026 Democratic primary and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot.
